$comment: How the bridge drives djay Pro, by keyboard shortcut. Cmd-Return (musicLibrary.markSelectedSongs, adds the selection to the Queue) and Shift-Cmd-Return (mixer.transitionActiveToInactive, mixes into the next deck) are taken from djay's own key bindings on the DJ laptop. Still to confirm by hand: that Cmd-F focuses the library search, and that Down then selects the first result (see README.md, 'Calibrating'). {query} is replaced with 'title artist'.
